question: Government of India has appointed _______ ​as Controller General of Accounts in October 2022
solution:
The correct answer is Bharati Das.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian government** has selected **Ms Bharati Das**, an **Indian Civil Accounts Service (ICAS)** officer from the 1988 batch, as the **department's controller general of accounts (CGA).**
 
• She has held significant positions in different **Central Ministries,** including the **Ministries of Foreign Affairs, Finance, Health, Home Affairs, and CBDT**.
 
• Before accepting the position of** Controller General of Accounts,** **Ms Bharati Das** held the position of **Pr. Chief Controller of Accounts (Pr. CCA) **in the Ministries of Foreign Affairs, Home Affairs, and later the **Central Board of Direct Taxes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Controller General of Accounts**

 
 
• The primary accounting advisor to the **GOI is the Controller General of Accounts (CGA).**
 
• The **Central and State Governments' debts, deposits, cash,** and other **financial activities** are all audited by him.
 
• The **CGA** specifies the form of accounts as well as the general accounting standards for the **federal and state governments.**
